D-FA-6.title: Zero-sign convention
D-FA-6.definition: sign(x) = +1 if x > 0; 0 if x = 0; -1 if x < 0. Two signs match only when the sign values are exactly equal.
consequences: zero does NOT match a positive or a negative estimate
D-FA-6.scope: Every analysis that compares effect direction or sign. In the frozen plan this is the cross-model consistency flag (plan §5; framework §2.8) and the replication-in-sign rule (framework §2.1).
D-FA-6.implementation: src/clsm/workshop_v1/final_analysis.py: sign(), cross_model_flag(). The flag is 'consistent' iff sign(estimate_model_1) == sign(estimate_model_2) and the difference-of-differences interval contains 0. No alternative convention is selectable; the zero_sign parameter and the unapproved 'compatible' option were removed.
D-FA-6.estimates_affected: None. The convention changes only the cross-model summary wording and Discussion branch selection, never an estimate or an interval.

agreed_only_G.title: Optional exploratory agreed-only G
agreed_only_G.decision: Do not add agreed-only G as an exploratory analysis. Do not implement or report it.
agreed_only_G.reason: The primary G and the already-frozen validation and sensitivity analyses are sufficient. Avoid an unnecessary post-generation exploratory estimand and extra multiplicity.
agreed_only_G.implementation_check: No agreed-only G estimator exists in final_analysis.py or final_tables.py. The row column human_source ('agreed'/'adjudicated') is provenance only and feeds no estimand.
